pages.title: Phase Diagram Kiln
pages.text: A kiln for alloys, run at the one mixture that melts all at once and sets the same all through.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the alloy ratio and the temperature. At the eutectic the alloy melts sharply and sets evenly; off it, it freezes in mush. The ratio must be within 0.01 of the eutectic, and the kiln just above its melting point.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Superconducting Solder.
